decision_checklist.summary: Treat expedited grace-period selection, waiting, and sequence completion as explicit stay-in-C boundaries.
decision_checklist.rationale: The expedited path still funnels CPU selection, IPI-driven quiescent-state forcing, timeout or stall handling, and sequence serialization through tightly coupled tree_exp.h logic that should remain in C.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep NOCB bypass locking and deferred wakeups in C while the survey records the callback-offload boundary.
decision_checklist.rationale: The NOCB path still relies on bypass-list pressure, kthread wakeup policy, and deferred GP wakeups across tree.c and tree_nocb.h, so Zigux should mark the boundary without inventing ownership over callback offload.

decision_checklist.summary: Keep quiescent-state propagation, per-node GP updates, and callback acceleration in C while the survey records how these paths stay coupled.
decision_checklist.rationale: Quiescent-state reporting still climbs the rcu_node hierarchy under lock, `note_gp_changes()` still folds gp-sequence changes into per-CPU callback state, and callback acceleration still depends on segmented callback lists and offload state, so this seam remains study-only.
